description: The Dryad collection includes HEC-RAS hydraulic model files for Connecticut River floodplain research transects. The models produce rating curves, stream power and other flow measures alongside vegetation, surveyed geometry and measured stage data. This resource is provided by Christian O. Marks; Keith H. Nislow; Francis J. Magilligan. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The model component is supplied as a ZIP with a DOCX readme. The enclosing ecological study covers more than 100 sites, but that does not establish the number of hydraulic model files. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
